question: Which recorded systems returned geometrically feasible plans that preserve the authored brief?
selection: Explicit CLI selection; no automatic latest or best-attempt selection

qualityMetric.numerator: Productive outcomes passing recorded geometry and brief checks
qualityMetric.denominator: Available graded outcomes, including explicit empty outcomes
qualityMetric.missingness: Unavailable outcomes stay missing; no zero-quality imputation
qualityMetric.aggregation: Analyzer-recorded task proportion; one trial per task
qualityMetric.rounding: One decimal place as percentage for display; full precision in CSV

invalidColumn: Geometry-invalid admitted plans / credited plans; plan units, not task units
uncertainty: No per-arm intervals invented; compatible paired comparisons are copied verbatim from analyzer

operationalSuccessAmongPairedScheduled.method: Paired scene-group percentile bootstrap; difference is trained minus base. Entire groups are sampled with replacement; no task-level independent resampling.

qualitySuccessAmongPairedAvailable.method: Paired scene-group percentile bootstrap; difference is trained minus base. Entire groups are sampled with replacement; no task-level independent resampling.

qualitySuccessAmongPairedAvailableWitnes.method: Paired scene-group percentile bootstrap; difference is trained minus base. Entire groups are sampled with replacement; no task-level independent resampling.

comparisons.interpretation: Operational success counts an unavailable scheduled pipeline outcome as no delivered plan. Quality estimates exclude unavailable outcomes rather than label them model mistakes. Paired-available estimates are conditional on observed availability and may be selected. Development remains diagnostic; these authored scene groups are not creators or real-world filming outcomes.

limitations: No current-code regrading or replacement of sealed outputs.
Unavailable quality outcomes stay missing; operational delivery failures use the scheduled denominator.
Known witnesses come only from compatible recorded deterministic checks; absence of a witness does not prove infeasibility.
Bootstrap uncertainty concerns these authored scene groups, not creators or general cinematic quality.
No creator benefit or training improvement is inferred from absent arms.
privacy: Metadata only; no prompts, credentials, footage or signed URLs
